The U-Net architecture is also a specific choice within neural networks. Therefore, 'bayesian nested neural network' may utilize a nested version of a Bayesian U-Net which makes it semantically equivalent in the context of Bayesian neural processing.

A 'bayesian model' is a broad category that encompasses any statistical model that incorporates Bayesian methods of inference. It forms the foundation of any model identified as 'Bayesian,' including 'bayesian u-net.' Thus, in a broad sense, it can be seen as semantically equivalent.

The term 'bayesian neural networks' describes a neural network model incorporating Bayesian inference. A 'bayesian u-net' is a type of Bayesian neural network specifically using the U-Net architecture for its applications, making it semantically equivalent in terms of the Bayesian neural framework.

A Bayesian neural network refers to a neural network that utilizes Bayesian inference for tasks such as updating the weight distributions based on data.
